item.title: OT: Debian 12 kernel bug leads to hang/freeze
item.author: invalid@example.com (SteveITS)
item.dc:creator: SteveITS
item.content:encoded:
This is not a Proxmox issue but I expect many are running Debian 12 VMs. It seems the 6.1.0-55 kernel from yesterday can cause random hangs:
https://www.mail-archive.com/debian-bugs-dist@lists.debian.org/msg2133975.html

Booting a prior kernel from the GRUB menu is a workaround.
